say:1:1430211401:1.text: There's a lot of good food in the commoners' district, but my favorite is grilled fish covered in flamefern jam.
say:1:1430211401:1.source_cn: 很多食物都能吃，但最喜欢的是火鳞草果酱配烤鱼。
say:1:1430211401:1.male: There's a lot of good food in the commoners' district, but my favorite is grilled fish covered in flamefern jam.
say:1:1430211401:1.female: There's a lot of good food in the commoners' district, but my favorite is grilled fish covered in flamefern jam.

say:2:1430211402:1.text: You can also sprinkle some spicy etching iris on top for seasoning.
say:2:1430211402:1.source_cn: 对了，还要再撒一些辛辣的蚀芯花调味！
say:2:1430211402:1.male: You can also sprinkle some spicy etching iris on top for seasoning.
say:2:1430211402:1.female: You can also sprinkle some spicy etching iris on top for seasoning.

say:3:1430211403:1.text: If you ask me, these are the types of food that fill a stomach. Those court dishes are only good for viewing pleasure.
say:3:1430211403:1.source_cn: 要我说这些才是填饱肚子的食物，那些精致的宫廷菜只适合观赏。
